grammar.title: New measure words: 条, 件, 场
grammar.explanation: 条 (tiáo) counts long, thin things like roads, rivers, or fish. 件 (jiàn) counts individual items, especially clothes or matters/affairs (一件事). 场 (chǎng) counts events such as a movie, a game, or a spell of rain.

grammar.title: By means of with 通过
grammar.pattern: 通过 + method/means, (主语) + verb phrase
grammar.explanation: 通过 (tōngguò) means "through, by means of". Put it before the way something is achieved, then say the result. It can also mean "to pass" a test or a law.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yí jiàn yīfu.
sentences.en: I bought a piece of clothing.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí jiàn zhòngyào de shì.
Zuótiān wǎnshang xià le yì chǎng yǔ.

sentences.zh: 通过学习，他知道了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò xuéxí, tā zhīdào le hěn duō.
sentences.en: Through studying, he came to know a lot.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tōngguò péngyou rènshi le tā.
sentences.en: I got to know her through a friend.

sentences.pinyin: Tā tōngguò le zhè cì kǎoshì.

sentences.zh: 通过电话，我们说了很多话。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngguò diànhuà, wǒmen shuō le hěn duō huà.
sentences.en: Through a phone call, we talked a lot.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ zuò de liǎo.
sentences.en: I can manage to do this.
